# Words that appeared in the five retired outline templates.
#
# Generated ONCE, from outline_templates.py, on the commit that deleted it.
# Do not edit by hand and do not regenerate: the templates no longer exist,
# so this file IS the record.
#
# WHY IT HAS TO EXIST. codex/scan.py subtracts template scaffolding from
# planned-name candidates -- measured at 53 planned names down to 23 on the
# writer's real outlines. Every project created before v2.0.2 still has a
# full template body sitting in notes/outline.md. Delete the renderers
# without keeping their vocabulary and the scan stops subtracting, and every
# existing writer's noise silently returns.
#
